description: Manifest of the India Threat Tracker data files. Each resource has its own structure and, where it is JSON, its own schema; there is no shared envelope.

watchlist.description: KEV entries that are India-relevant (high or medium) and added in the last 24 calendar months or ransomware-linked

exploited-cve.description: Every CISA KEV entry, enriched with FIRST EPSS and an India-relevance tier, with EPSS enrichment health

smishing-apk.description: Fake-APK and smishing campaigns affecting Indian users

apt-campaigns.description: State-nexus actors targeting India, plus regional context

assessment.description: Ranked analyst assessment of what matters this month, with evidence references to feed records and sources

relevance-overrides.description: Hand-reviewed India-relevance decisions; the pipeline reads them and never writes them

iocs-csv.description: Defanged campaign indicators with provenance per row; never contains infrastructure context

iocs-txt.description: The same indicators, one per line, with a provenance header

stix.description: STIX 2.1 Bundle of campaigns, intrusion sets, indicators, malware, ATT&CK techniques, referenced CVEs and the monthly assessment; see STIX-GUIDE.md

kev-affected.derived_from: data/exploited-cve.json and the official CVE records (CVE Project cvelistV5)
kev-affected.description: Affected products and versions for every KEV CVE, as the CVE record states them; the Exposure Matcher's vulnerability data
